NAME: Security Hub Management
DESCRIPTION:
The options for this service correspond to things sold as part of a security hub.
            This service should not be attached to any (monitored) mission control hosts.

NAME: Management Host (logmon)
DESCRIPTION: OSAG management host (GUMA, jump hosts, Balu, Redis, etc.)

NAME: Network Detection and Response
DESCRIPTION: Open Systems Network Detection and Response

NAME: OSAG Monitored Host
DESCRIPTION: Monitored non-OSIX management host (Oracle, Ipanema, etc.)
